vo01.text: Buy a gift card online, and you hand over your email, your card, your name. Every purchase becomes a record of you.

captions.text: Buy a gift card online, and you hand over your email, your card, your name.
Every purchase becomes a record of you.

vo02.text: So we built Chupke. It's Hindi for “quietly”.

captions.text: So we built Chupke.
It's Hindi for “quietly”.

vo03.text: You pay in shielded ZEC. An agent buys the card on Bitrefill, and sends the code straight to your own wallet, as an encrypted memo. No account. No email.

captions.text: You pay in shielded ZEC.
An agent buys the card on Bitrefill, and sends the code straight to your own wallet, as an encrypted memo.
No account. No email.

vo04.text: This is live, on testnet. I pick a card, and paste a fresh address from my wallet.

captions.text: This is live, on testnet.
I pick a card, and paste a fresh address from my wallet.

vo05.text: Then I pay the QR, from a shielded wallet.

captions.text: Then I pay the QR, from a shielded wallet.

vo06.text: The agent sees the payment, checks the limits, and buys the card from the shop's own Bitrefill balance.

captions.text: The agent sees the payment, checks the limits, and buys the card from the shop's own Bitrefill balance.

vo07.text: And about a minute later, the code is in my wallet. Only my wallet can read it.

captions.text: And about a minute later, the code is in my wallet.
Only my wallet can read it.

vo08.text: And it's careful with money. If the card fails, you're refunded, with the reason. Over the limit? Refunded. Pay twice? Refunded.

captions.text: And it's careful with money.

vo09.text: We even killed the agent mid-delivery. It still sent exactly one code.

captions.text: We even killed the agent mid-delivery.

vo10.text: Bitrefill never learns who you are. The chain sees only encrypted data. Codes are never stored, and your reply address is deleted an hour after delivery.

vo11.text: The public site holds no keys. A private worker, with a view-only inbox, does the buying.

Chupke. Gift cards, bought quietly.
